frequency_question: How often is a successor transboundary water treaty signed before or shortly after the expiration of the preceding long-term treaty?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral water-sharing treaties of 20+ years duration between sovereign states that have reached or passed their expiration date. Excludes domestic water pacts and multilateral basin conventions.
window: Within a window spanning 2 years prior to expiration up to 3 years post-expiration

cases.name: 1944 US-Mexico Water Treaty modifications / successor minutes

provenance_note: 3 cases named, 4 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.3x)
coverage_note: 3 named and verified; estimated 4 total major comparable historical instances globally within the defined class.
known_gaps: Limited global dataset of 30-year bilateral water treaties reaching expiration.
skeleton: Major transboundary water treaty renewals or successor agreements globally over the last 50 years
multiplier: 4 distinct regional river basin treaty renewal processes examined across South Asia and North America
validity_reason: International water law norms and bilateral riparian dependency dynamics change slowly over multi-decade spans.
